name: misar-blog
description: Write, publish, and grow a blog — articles, series, newsletters, cover images, analytics — from any AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Misar.Blog lets you write, publish and grow a blog from ChatGPT. Draft and edit articles, publish now or schedule for later, organise posts into series, research topics, generate SEO-friendly titles and cover images, and review comments, reactions, newsletter subscribers and traffic.

It is built for writers, creators and teams who publish on Misar.Blog. A Misar.Blog account is required, and the plugin only changes articles owned by the signed-in account.
defaultPrompt: Write a complete, SEO-optimised article draft and save it.
Show me my top-performing articles this month.
Suggest five better titles for my latest draft.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the account's draft articles with title and status, including "Five ways to grow a newsletter".

positive.prompt: Save a draft titled "Getting started with email automation" with a short introduction paragraph.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm an unpublished draft with that title was saved and return its slug.

positive.prompt: Suggest five SEO-friendly titles for an article about remote team onboarding.
positive.expected_behavior: Return five title options for the topic, each with the keyword angle it targets.

positive.prompt: How did my blog perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Return page views and other headline metrics for the trailing 30 days.
Return the account's series with their titles, including "Email marketing basics".

negative.description: Brainstorming only; nothing is saved or published
negative.prompt: Give me five name ideas for a personal travel blog.

negative.description: Editing text the user pasted; no article is created
negative.prompt: Proofread this paragraph for grammar and tone: "Our team have been working hard on the new release."

negative.description: Question about a different blogging platform
negative.prompt: What kinds of posts are trending on Medium this week?

review.commerce_description: Misar.Blog does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Adds the Misar task skills, OAuth sign-in, and updated branding.
